note: An issue-driven package deploy: the deploy job runs on issues (opened, edited, labeled) and pastes github.event.issue.body and github.event.issue.title into a shell, in a job holding INLED_REPO_PAT (the token that uploads to the package repository) and a declared contents: write token. The admin check is a shell step earlier in the job, which the facts cannot read. The declared contents: write token is a privilege and the writes-to-the-repository impact at once, so an untrusted expression into this job is Critical on its base tier; main is unprotected and the path writes the repository, so the branch gate applies too, the tier already at its ceiling.
